name: Papirus Icon Theme
summary: Large, pixel-perfect icon theme in Papirus, Papirus Dark and Papirus Light variants
description: Papirus is one of the most complete icon themes for Linux, with sharp icons for thousands of apps, folders, devices and MIME types. It ships Papirus, Papirus-Dark, Papirus-Light and ePapirus variants, plus hardcoded-icon fixes. Set it as your icon theme after installing.
